title: Planning the attack
description: George Lucas severed all of his remaining ties to the Hollywood system after the worldwide success of The Empire Strikes Back had made him a truly independent filmmaker. But there were negatives to this otherwise admirable position. Lucasfilm was a non-union company, and that, according to Return of the Jedi producer Howard Kazanjian, made acquiring shooting locations more difficult and extremely expensive. Even though A New Hope and The Empire Strikes Back were mammoth hits, and George Lucas had enormous clout at this juncture, the physical and financial producing of this third Star Wars installment proved a daunting challenge for all concerned.
